status: Prepared before main-study scoring; human assessments and analysis have not run
authority: Plan and public result preparation authorised; judging, regeneration and thesis editing are not authorised by this preparation.

matched_original_scoring_bridge.rule: The identical historical run-1 texts for all 18 tasks, four models and three variants, matched by source hash and cell identity.

scope.scale: Each metric is an integer 1-5 with higher better. Preserve four separate outcomes; no primary composite score or unannounced metric weighting.
scope.population: The finite set of selected task instances and deployed models. Three generation repeats measure stochastic variation within a cell; they are not independent task samples.

primary_estimands.within_model: For each metric, task, model and variant, average the three repeat scores; subtract the corresponding naive repeat mean within the same task and model. Report all six task contrasts, then their equal-weight mean within each model.
primary_estimands.repeat_pairing: Run index is a replicate label, not a shared stochastic seed across variants. Do not claim common-random-number matching or treat 18 repeat differences as 18 independent tasks.
primary_estimands.weighting: Equal weight per task and per repeat within a complete cell. Report each model separately; any across-model summary gives each of the three models equal weight and is descriptive.
primary_estimands.family: All 24 primary model/contrast/metric summaries are mandatory (3 models x 2 contrasts x 4 metrics). Do not select a positive metric/model after viewing results or turn one favourable cell into a general success claim.
primary_estimands.ordinal_caution: Score means and differences summarise the anchored scale, not calibrated interval measurements of latent quality. Accompany them with score-frequency distributions, medians/ranges and task-level win/tie/loss counts.
primary_estimands.secondary_contrast: peil_labelled minus peil_unlabelled for all four metrics, explicitly secondary.

uncertainty_and_inference.primary: Descriptive estimates with all six task-level effects visible. No confirmatory significance tests or universal superiority claims are planned for this purposively selected six-task study.
uncertainty_and_inference.sensitivity: Report leave-one-task-out ranges and the predeclared task-resampling sensitivity intervals consistently for every primary mean contrast.

task_resampling.method: Resample six entire task blocks with replacement; retain all models, variants and repeats within each selected block. Report the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles as a task-resampling sensitivity interval.
task_resampling.interpretation: Only six selected task clusters exist. This interval describes sensitivity to task composition; it is not evidence of random sampling from all tasks or a calibrated population confidence interval.

uncertainty_and_inference.within_cell_variation: Show three observed repeat scores or their range; do not infer a reliable per-cell distribution from n=3.
uncertainty_and_inference.multiplicity: All outcomes/contrasts remain visible; no dichotomous significance decision is made. Any later inferential hypothesis testing must be labelled exploratory or separately specified before use.

historical_analysis.all_runs: Recompute the same within-task/model contrasts under the final common judging protocol for all 648 historical responses; keep results separate from corrective results.
historical_analysis.missing_input_partition: Report the six affected historical tasks separately from the other twelve, and report essential-input-missing versus present/not-required. Do not relabel missing-input responses as corrected.
historical_analysis.bridge_216: For each metric on the matched original run-1 subset, show old/new 5x5 score-transition tables, exact and within-one-point agreement, paired score changes, and changes in naive-to-PEIL contrasts/rankings. Keep the original score artifacts unchanged.
historical_analysis.bridge_limit: Judge model, presentation, explicit anchors and reference/format/clarification rules changed together. Bridge differences cannot be attributed solely to Astra. Do not pool old and new ratings or assume a numerical conversion between protocols.
historical_analysis.calibration_reuse: Mark the 12 previously observed calibration source responses. Main-study scoring still uses fresh ratings under the frozen final plan; calibration ratings are never substituted. Present a sensitivity analysis excluding those 12 from historical summaries, with changed denominators explicit; do not call reused cases an untouched validation set.

cross_cohort_and_taxonomy.cross_cohort: Show historical and corrective results side by side as different cohorts. Input restoration, contemporary generator models and system/user role placement changed together; their separate causal effects are not identified.
cross_cohort_and_taxonomy.model_comparison: Sol/Luna/Grok comparisons are descriptive; generation settings and reasoning compute are not equalised. Astra shares the OpenAI provider family with Sol and Luna.
cross_cohort_and_taxonomy.taxonomy: Use stable task IDs for primary scoring and analysis. Resolve task-versus-technique mappings before category-level claims; maintain a versioned mapping table and preserve original labels. Do not claim the six corrected tasks cover all six logic categories.
cross_cohort_and_taxonomy.scope: No result generalises automatically to other tasks, prompt patterns, papers, model versions or later deployments.

response_status_and_missingness.clarification: Retain appropriate clarifications: accuracy/completeness 1 under v3, with formatting/fabrication assessed independently. Report answer-status and appropriate-clarification frequencies separately so low attainment is not presented as fabricated behaviour.
response_status_and_missingness.hypotheticals: Keep v3 distinctions between requested illustrations, clearly labelled hypotheticals accompanying requests for missing data, and invented actual task facts.
response_status_and_missingness.not_zero: Invalid or absent judge ratings are missing, never score 0 or 1 by default. No imputation or exclusion based on a low/unfavourable score.
response_status_and_missingness.completion_gate: Prefer analysis only after 810 valid planned ratings and integrity checks. If unresolved failures remain, report exact missing cells/denominators and do not present a complete-balanced analysis.
response_status_and_missingness.retries: Runner is append-only and disables automatic retries. On network, unknown-outcome, schema, quote or model/config failure, stop and preserve attempt/raw evidence. Any later retry needs a linked append-only attempt/version and reason; never overwrite or keep retrying for a preferred rating.
response_status_and_missingness.selection_rule: Use the first schema-valid rating obtained under unchanged frozen settings for a response; preserve all invalid/unknown attempts. Do not regenerate a valid rating simply because its score is unexpected.
response_status_and_missingness.configuration_change: If judge deployment/build, protocol, references, schema or settings materially change, stop and create a new version; do not silently pool mixed versions.

human_review.purpose: An independent-of-Astra assessment of a preselected balanced sample plus targeted evidence adjudication. It is not a claim that human assessments already exist.

corrective_sample.strata: One response from every task x current-model x variant cell, selecting one of its three repeats. This covers 6 x 3 x 3 cells.
corrective_sample.selection: Sort 54 strata by SHA-256 of a canonical JSON object containing selection seed, cohort and stratum. Assign repeat 1+(index mod 3), giving 18 of each repeat. Pick the unique matching planned job.

historical_sample.strata: One response per task x variant (18 x 3).
historical_sample.selection: Sort the 54 strata by SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing selection seed, cohort, nonce and stratum. In that order assign model by index mod 4 over a frozen lexicographically sorted model list, and repeat 1+(index mod 3). This gives model counts 14/14/13/13 and repeat counts 18/18/18. Use the smallest nonnegative nonce whose selected source hashes exclude all 12 prior calibration source responses; abort selection rather than silently relaxing this exclusion if no nonce 0..999 succeeds.

human_review.sample_freeze: Record selection algorithm, model ordering, seed/nonce, selected job/source hashes and final masked presentation order before any new judge scores are read. The selector may use metadata and hashes only, never response quality or judge score.
human_review.presentation: Reviewer first receives neutral audited task facts/common requirements, the same rubric/policies and response text under an opaque review ID. Hide generator, variant, taxonomy, cohort label, run number and Astra scores/rationales. Writing style can still reveal condition/model; record partial masking rather than complete blinding.
human_review.ratings: At least one named human reviewer records all four 1-5 scores, answer_status, appropriate_clarification, exact supporting quotes, uncertainty and verification needs independently before seeing Astra ratings. Prefer a supervisor/second reviewer who did not design the prompts; author review is acceptable if clearly disclosed, not labelled independent external validation.
human_review.grounding_second_pass: After the independent common-rubric pass is locked, inspect the exact submitted generation prompt for the sampled historical missing-input cases and for any disputed grounding claim, especially CAL-08. Record this as a separate prompt-grounding audit; full prompt visibility can reveal treatment. Do not silently feed it into or change the frozen Astra protocol.
human_review.targeted_set: Separately review all needs_human_review flags, suspected reference conflicts/unverified source claims, structural anomalies, and the predeclared CAL-06/07/08/12 boundary cases even if the judge flag is false. Targeted cases are not part of an unbiased agreement sample and must be labelled separately; deduplicate overlaps with the base sample.
human_review.agreement: On the base sample, report per-metric exact agreement, within-one-point agreement, mean absolute ordinal-score difference, signed difference, and status confusion tables, with separate historical/corrective denominators. Do not treat sample agreement as a general accuracy estimate across all LLM tasks.
human_review.adjudication_trigger: A difference of at least 2 points on any metric, answer_status/appropriate_clarification disagreement, unsupported reference fact, or disagreement about invented actual inputs triggers explicit adjudication. Prefer a second human for these cases; record when only the original reviewer can resolve one.
human_review.adjudication_records: Append reviewer identities, locked independent scores, evidence, decision, reason and timestamps; retain original Astra ratings unchanged. Primary reports use the raw frozen-protocol Astra scores. Report human/Astra comparisons on the fixed base sample and targeted adjudication outcomes separately. Do not create a primary hybrid dataset by replacing only selected ratings. Any human-corrected full-cohort sensitivity analysis needs a separately specified complete affected-scope rule, with comparable coverage and disclosed selection.
human_review.blocking_reference_issue: A material reference/rubric error found in human review blocks affected substantive claims and requires a versioned protocol correction with a justified complete affected-scope rerating, not ad hoc patching of selected answers.
human_review.claim_gate: No final thesis performance claims until the preselected sample, targeted flags and reference conflicts have been reviewed or explicitly reported as unresolved with limits.

preparation_decisions_and_defaults.default: 108 preselected responses plus all targeted ambiguities; reviewer names not yet assigned.
preparation_decisions_and_defaults.required_before: Human review begins; identities need not block saving the plan.

preparation_decisions_and_defaults.default: Finite-benchmark descriptive contrasts, six-task sensitivity and no confirmatory p-values.
Stable task IDs only; defer grouped taxonomy claims until the classification record is resolved.
preparation_decisions_and_defaults.required_before: Category-level interpretation, not neutral response scoring.

preparation_decisions_and_defaults.default: Record observed Astra deployment version/upgrade policy and stop on any detected change; do not promise provider-weight immutability from an alias.

limitations: This is a dated analysis plan made after the original study and calibration, before final main-study scores. It is not prospective preregistration of the original study or corrective collection.
The calibration is diagnostic and AI-assisted. Four preselected boundary cases were not flagged by Astra; manual-review selection must be independent of that flag.
CAL-08 remains a prompt-grounding limitation because Astra receives intended reference facts and a missing-input status, not the complete original generation prompt.
No experiments, judging, human ratings, score analysis or thesis edits were performed while preparing this document.
